v11-13.candidate: David called him, and he ate and drank before him, and David made him drunk. In the evening Uriah went out to lie on his bed with his lord’s servants, but he did not go down to his house.

v11-15.candidate: He wrote in the letter, “Bring Uriah to face the fiercest battle, and you all shall withdraw from behind him, and he will be struck and die.”

v12-12.candidate: For you acted in secret, but I will do this thing before all Israel and before this sun.’”

v12-18.candidate: On the seventh day the child died. David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child had died, for they said, “Behold, while the child was still alive, we spoke to him and he did not listen to us. How can we tell him that the child has died? He will do harmful things.”
